scientific_conclusion: Increment-level history commitment (freezing predictor history H_cand) stabilizes intra-increment staggered solves, preventing the explosive strain ratcheting seen in R7. At +1 nm loading, the predictor history is insufficient to advance damage beyond the transferred bound d0, leaving the crack locked in the pre-propagation elastic state (d_max = 0.6550, Delta E_frac = 0.0 mJ). However, during active crack propagation, freezing predictor history suppresses legitimate crack advance and creates an unresolved physical residual (r_d > 1e-6 kN/mm) whenever post-softening strain localization raises true strain energy above H_cand.
